arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. DRAW an actual graphite staging storyboard with TWO wide panels stacked vertically. Not final art. References 1 Neet original body, 2 Buddy original body (blurred stride no ratios), 3 Buddy sitting face furnishings, 4 provisional model interpreted structure only. Panel 1 morning living room: shrine with Ganesh murti and orange marigolds at rear; Buddy stands beside his rumpled blanket one front paw on its edge, looks pleading toward Neet. Neet stands beside blanket turned toward Buddy, alert ears and mildly embarrassed gravitas. Two dogs only; no text. Panel 2 lakeshore: same two dogs seated on dry shore, three-quarter rear/side view so faces visible in profile; watching a few orange marigold petals blowing over water. Small Ganesh murti far in water, festive people very distant only. Quiet affectionate farewell, not funeral. Clearly draw connected ribcage pelvis neck, leg roots four limbs each, grounded paws and seated haunches, proper occlusion. Neet full narrow tan torso fine long legs huge triangular ears tiny nub smooth coat. Buddy moderate elongated full torso substantial legs and clearance, projected irregular moustache beard brows and ear/paw regional furnishings, slender modest-fringe tail. No curly body texture or fluff. No uniforms or humanized hands.
